note: Host log sources and the evidence category of each event (paper Section 6.1: process creation = Sysmon 1 and Security 4688; network connections = Sysmon 3; file activity = Sysmon 11; registry activity = Sysmon 12-14; authentication = Security 4624, 4625, 4648; script execution = PowerShell 4104; service and scheduled-task activity = Security 4697, 4698). 'channel' is the Windows event-log channel (winlog.channel in Winlogbeat/ECS); 'keywords' are names that identify the source in free text, needed for Sysmon's small event ids. 'names' describe events for the intent model's event digest (including events outside the seven categories); they never create evidence.

names.4672: special privileges assigned to new logon
names.4732: member added to security-enabled local group
